profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
In 2016, I attended my first Data science interview at a product company. It
wasn’t a great experience. It was full day interview : written - cleared,
hands on with data - cleared, after 7 hours into process, I walked into
interview room with a lot of hope. The first question was - Do you know Mongo
DB. I replied No and it was a reject. Came out within 2 mins and felt very bad
for time and trauma. And that day I made my mind not go to every interview ! I
have put my own systems in place to wade off irrelevant interview
opportunities! A month ago, Director of Engineering of the same company pinged
me to hire students of end to end data science course. When I didn’t revert,
he followed me up ! No...Am not talking about revenge or success. If you ever
felt humiliated in interview, don’t wait for motivation ever Focus on
excellence.
